aboutText: TNT Stonemason Pty Ltd has been crafting high-quality monuments in Braybrook for over 30 years. We specialise in custom-made gravestones, lawn headstones, bronze plaques, and additional inscriptions throughout Victorian cemeteries. Our purpose is to keep your memories alive with attention to detail and budget-friendly options. From design to installation, we ensure every piece is made with care.
servicesText: At TNT Stonemason, we specialise in creating lasting tributes and functional stone pieces for homes and cemeteries across Braybrook. With over 30 years of experience, we handle everything from design to installation with meticulous care. Our services include gravestone monuments, headstones, plaques, and marble benchtops.

services.title: Gravestone Monuments
services.desc: We design and craft custom gravestone monuments, ensuring each piece honours your loved ones with dignity and respect.

services.title: Lawn Headstones
services.desc: Our lawn headstones are carefully designed and crafted to meet cemetery standards while providing a personal touch to memorialise your loved ones.

services.title: Bronze Plaques
services.desc: We offer elegant bronze plaques that are engraved with precision and constructed to withstand time, perfect for memorials.

services.title: Additional Inscriptions & Renovations
services.desc: Our team adds new inscriptions or renovates existing tombstones, ensuring they are updated or restored with the utmost care and detail.

services.title: Monumental Accessories
services.desc: We provide a variety of monumental accessories that complement and complete your monument design, adding the finishing touches with style.

services.title: Marble Benchtops & Vanities
services.desc: We install high-quality marble surfaces for kitchens, vanities, and BBQ areas, bringing elegance and durability to your home spaces.
